R308_evidence_summary: Yield-matched drainage achieved 16.5% vs 30% pre-registered target. Failed by 13.5 percentage points. Diagnosis: estimator noise — the yield estimator is too noisy to achieve 30% target.
R309_role: REPAIR CANDIDATE — one repair attempt. Diagnose: mechanism failure (yield matching fundamentally noisy) vs. implementation failure (estimator design).
R309_action_plan: Step 1: Diagnose using SIM_SVFSI. Is the noise a fundamental CSF flow variability issue or a sensor/estimator design issue?
Step 2: If implementation failure (estimator design): repair estimator (e.g., Kalman filter, Bayesian estimator), re-run. If PASS, proceed through completion pipeline.
Step 3: If mechanism failure (fundamental noise floor): can the target be relaxed to 20% (still clinically useful)? If yes, re-preregister at 20% and re-run. If no, P-14 → cemetery.
Step 4: Document diagnosis with provenance (Article XXIX).
R309_target_state: EITHER TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY (if estimator fix or target relaxation) OR CEMETERY (if fundamental noise floor) OR REPLACEMENT_FROM_RESERVOIR
machine_blockers: Diagnosis must clearly separate implementation vs. mechanism failure.
